cases.question: Should I share my OTP with a bank employee?
cases.answer: Customers should never share their one-time password (OTP), PIN, or password with anyone, including a bank employee.
cases.evidence:
# Fictional Policy: Account Security

Customers should never share their one-time password (OTP), PIN, or password with anyone, including a bank employee.

If a customer suspects unauthorized account access, they should immediately use the official banking app or the verified customer-support channel to secure the account.

The bank will never ask a customer to disclose their full password or OTP over a phone call, email, or chat.

Customers should review account activity regularly and report unfamiliar transactions through the official support channel.

cases.question: What details should I include when disputing a card transaction?
cases.answer: A dispute request should include the transaction date, amount, merchant name if available, and a short description of why the transaction is disputed.
cases.evidence:
# Fictional Policy: Debit and Credit Card Disputes

Customers should report an unfamiliar card transaction as soon as possible using the official banking app or verified customer-support channel.

A dispute request should include the transaction date, amount, merchant name if available, and a short description of why the transaction is disputed.

Submitting a dispute does not guarantee a refund; the bank reviews the evidence and communicates the outcome through an official channel.

Customers should never send a full card number, PIN, password, or OTP in an unsecured message.

cases.question: What should I verify before confirming a digital transfer?
cases.answer: Before confirming a digital transfer, customers should verify the recipient name, destination details, and amount.
cases.evidence:
# Fictional Policy: Digital Transfers

Before confirming a digital transfer, customers should verify the recipient name, destination details, and amount.

Transfer limits and processing times can depend on the payment method, account type, and applicable bank rules.

If a transfer appears pending, customers should check the official transaction status before initiating another transfer.

If a customer believes a transfer was unauthorized, they should report it promptly through the official banking app or verified customer-support channel.
